articles.title: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO
articles.summary: Switch Inc. filed confidentially for a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme.
articles.author: Bailey Lipschultz

articles.title: JPMorgan Boosts Tech Bond Sales Outlook as AI Debt Binge Expands
articles.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. sees bond sales from technology-related firms exceeding half a trillion dollars this year, as hyperscalers’ appetite to deploy capital for the artificial intelligence buildout shows no sign of abating despite growing investor fatigue.
articles.author: Charlotte Plaskwa

articles.title: Don't Delete, Archive: How I Safely "Retired" Zombie Code with `git mv` and `_archive/`
articles.summary: Hey everyone, it's your friendly neighborhood old-timer dev here. As a solo dev building AI trading bots in my spare time, projects can quickly spiral into chaos. A particularly thorny issue I ran into was "zombie functionality" — old scripts and their associated notifications, from strategies I'd long since abandoned, refusing to die. Lately, I'd noticed a significant amount of noise in my Slack notifications from the bot. It was genuinely distracting. When I finally sat down to investigate, I discovered that some old, long-unused scripts were still firing off more than ten notifications a day. This was my "zombie notification" problem. This is a subtle but dangerous problem. Critical alerts like "Account balance dropped significantly!" can easily get buried under a flood of meaningless notifications. articles.title: AI Data Center Group Firmus Draws $2 Billion From Coatue, Nvidia
articles.summary: AI data center company Firmus raised $2 billion in a funding round backed by Coatue Management, Nvidia Corp., Blackstone Inc. vehicles and Jane Street, the company said.
articles.author: Ainslie Chandler

articles.title: CAIS CEO Talks New Funding Round, AI’s Fintech Impact
articles.summary: Matt Brown, Founder, Chairman, and CEO of CAIS, discussed the company's recent $170 million Series D funding round led by Vista and supported by Allianz Bernstein, Blue Owl, and Carlyle, which values the alternative asset investment platform at over $2 billion—more than double its previous valuation. Brown highlighted CAIS's 37% organic growth and explained that the new capital will be used to pursue strategic mergers and acquisitions in response to ongoing fintech industry consolidation, enhance AI capabilities to improve the platform's user experience for advisers and asset managers, and provide liquidity to long-term shareholders through an institutional tender offer facilitated by Nasdaq Private Markets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Cloudflare Lifts Annual Profit Outlook, Beats Wall Street Target
articles.summary: Cloudflare Inc. gave a forecast for profit this year that topped Wall Street’s estimates, suggesting that demand for networking services continued to accelerate amid rapid adoption of artificial intelligence.
articles.author: Ignacio Gonzalez

articles.title: DeepSeek Resumes $8 Billion Round With Monolith in the Running
articles.summary: DeepSeek has resumed its second funding round, seeking close to $8 billion, with Monolith Management in talks to contribute, according to people familiar with the matter.
articles.author: Haze Fan and Pei Li

articles.title: China’s Unitree Seeks $904 Million in First Mainland Robotic IPO
articles.summary: China’s Yushu Technology Co., known as Unitree Robotics, is seeking to raise about 6.1 billion yuan ($904 million) in an initial public offering that would make it the mainland’s first publicly traded humanoid robot maker.
